panels.rationale: Fetal MRI at 25 weeks of gestation in a dichorionic-diamniotic twin pregnancy with Simpson-Golabi-Behmel Syndrome. The image is a real patient MRI visibly showing massive polyhydramnios surrounding the fetus, a recognized prenatal manifestation of SGBS caused by the affected co-twin (fetus II), which compressed fetus I into a stuck-twin-like appearance. Disease attribution is supported by the disease-focused article title together with the captioned manifestation (polyhydramnios); fetal overgrowth is supported by the in-text statement that all biometric measurements (HC-AC-FL) were above the 95th percentile. Polyhydramnios itself is not in the allowed vocabulary and is therefore recorded as a proposed finding. No third-party restriction, adequate image quality.
